limitations: Technical replicate is a global injection index (1..39) because one source (e.g. diluted standard BLAST1) is injected in all runs.
The three April 2021 close-out files are not in the repository mapping; layout assumed from the other TMTpro2 runs. The unsuffixed '_2_2021...' file is not labelled with a close-out setting.
Standard channels carry no precise cell numbers (250 pg peptide per channel).
Search parameters from the paper/PRIDE text, not from search result files.
